history_policy: strict past [t-window,t); original readings only; same vehicle and segment; invalid readings omitted from statistics and counted; no labels
b_policy: latest same-vehicle same-segment timestamp <= target timestamp; TTL from frozen cleaning dictionary; latest invalid blocks earlier valid; simultaneous timestamp batch assumed available
sequence: A RF exact replay; A unweighted control
B values RF and tree; B plus age RF
accept each feature increment only if macro gain >=0.005 and per-vehicle supported Macro-F1/normal recall no worse than parent by >0.02
if accepted B leaves >=20 binary errors, test C30; only after C30 acceptance test additional C60
on chosen feature group: no weight, leaf10, depth24 separately vs fixed RF
eligible models: validation normal recall and V1/V2 supported Macro-F1 >= A baseline minus0.02; best Macro-F1, within0.002 prefer fewer nodes then fewer encoded features then model id
seeds43/44 repeat chosen configuration and A, for stability audit only; do not reselect
sensitivity: selected model validation B states restricted to age<=2 seconds
selected model validation B states with existing quality-review flags masked
selected model validation history extended fields masked if their raw sources carry review flags
selected model validation B excludes simultaneous OTHER-variable readings (current target value remains A)
quality-flagged target vs other target errors
test_policy: No test feature matrix, model fitting, prediction, evaluation, or selection. No train+validation refit in stage5.
selection_status: development recommendation only; stage6 freezes final method and evaluates reserved test
